title: DIS attack and defense
summary: Attacking and defending a physical RPL network.
description:
Conducted DIS flooding and IPv6 attacks on a physical IoT network using the RPL (Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks) routing protocol, then protected it with rate limiting and MAC-address-based filtering in Contiki-NG.

Wireshark packet analysis validated the mitigation and showed the reduction in malicious traffic.
